name: Raven Tower
storyline:
In the realm of Alzor, on the continent of Telvar, the north sinks under the Great Mist while Val'Gard endures as the last great city of the south. Over its walls rises the Black Spire — one hundred and fifty floors of sealed history, locked vaults, and enemies that do not sleep.

Players enter Val'Gard as new blood: they train, raid the roads, trade in the markets, join brotherhoods, and step onto the Arena sand. Every climb toward the Spire's peak digs deeper into what the city buried, and what waits above the Mist.
summary:
Krucza Wieża is a free dark fantasy browser RPG set in the Polish city of Val'Gard at the foot of the Black Spire. Players build a character, spend the day on expeditions and training, craft gear, trade with others, join a brotherhood, and climb a 150-floor tower while competing in Arena PvP duels.

The game runs entirely in the browser with progress saved on the server. Combat is stance-based and resolved in round-by-round playback, with class styles and companions shaping each fight. Daily events, a season book, and a player market sit around the long climb of the Spire.
